text: 证监会公众公司监管司一级巡视员商庆军在2026金融街论坛年会上表示，证监会将立足服务创新型中小企业定位，发布北交所创新性评价标准，更加精准识别各类创新要素，明确申报预期，更好服务处于行业细分领域前沿，具有较强创新能力、持续成长潜力和专业化发展优势的创新型中小企业，持续优化上市公司结构；进一步强化新三板规范培育功能，健全准入和退出机制，优化新三板分层管理，增强创新层品牌效应和创新属性，完善差异化信息披露安排，巩固北交所与新三板“层层递进、上下联动、头部反哺、底层助推”的发展格局，为专精特新企业提供持续接力、精准适配的资本市场服务，更好赋能新质生产力发展。（
text_en: Shang Qingjun, a first-level inspector of the CSRC's Public Company Supervision Department, said at the 2026 Financial Street Forum Annual Meeting that the CSRC will, based on its positioning of serving innovative small and medium-sized enterprises, release innovation evaluation standards for the Beijing Stock Exchange, more accurately identify various innovation elements, clarify filing expectations, better serve innovative SMEs at the forefront of industry segments with strong innovation capabilities, sustained growth potential and specialized development advantages, and continuously optimize the structure of listed companies; further strengthen the NEEQ's standardized cultivation function, improve the admission and exit mechanisms, optimize the NEEQ's tiered management, enhance the brand effect and innovation attributes of the Innovation Tier, improve differentiated information disclosure arrangements, and consolidate the development pattern of "progressive tiers, upper-lower linkage, top-tier feedback, and bottom-tier support" between the Beijing Stock Exchange and the NEEQ, providing continuous, relay-style and precisely adapted capital market services for specialized, refined, distinctive and innovative enterprises and better empowering the development of new quality productive forces.
